raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

`--cpu-offload-gb` crashes at startup during CUDA graph capture when pinned memory is unavailable, which is the default on WSL2. This disables CUDA graphs for that combination, with a warning that names `VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1` as the way to keep them. Related: #37883 (WSL2 offload crashes, closed as stale), #46690 (open, reworks the same fallback wrapper; complementary, see Details).

## Claims

- WSL2 default (`VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY` unset) with `--cpu-offload-gb`: startup no longer crashes; the engine runs with torch.compile and without CUDA graphs.
- Pinned-memory platforms (native Linux, or WSL2 with the env var) are unchanged: the new check is skipped and CUDA graphs are still captured.

## Validation

**Unit test** `tests/test_config.py::test_cpu_offload_without_pinned_memory_disables_cudagraphs` calls `CudaPlatform.check_and_update_config` with pinned memory unavailable / available. On main the unavailable case fails (`PIECEWISE == NONE`); with this PR both cases pass.

**End to end** on an RTX 4050 Laptop 6 GB, WSL2 (Ubuntu 24.04, driver 581.86), torch 2.13.0+cu130, main `dac35c5b`, Qwen3-0.6B, `LLM(..., cpu_offload_gb=...)` with defaults otherwise (V2 runner, torch.compile, CUDA graphs), greedy, 3 prompts x 32 tokens:

| Run | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `cpu_offload_gb=0.5`, pinned memory off (WSL2 default) | offloads 0.51 GiB, then `RuntimeError: Cannot copy between CPU and CUDA tensors during CUDA graph capture unless the CPU tensor is pinned` | starts with the new warning, offloads 0.51 GiB (model loading 0.62 GiB vs 1.12 GiB without offload), token ids identical to the no-offload run |
| `cpu_offload_gb=0.5`, `VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1` | CUDA graphs captured | CUDA graphs captured (unchanged path) |
| `cpu_offload_gb=0` | CUDA graphs captured | CUDA graphs captured |

On main, the same offload run with `compilation_config={"cudagraph_mode": "NONE"}` works and gives the same tokens as the no-offload run, which is the configuration this PR selects. Token comparisons across restarts are affected by #58899 (Inductor picks reduction configs by timing): two unmodified-main runs of the pinned arm already differ from each other in one of the three prompts, so I only claim that the no-pin run starts and generates correctly, not bitwise equality across all restarts.

## Details

Root cause: `is_uva_available()` requires pinned memory, so without it `UVAOffloader` takes its fallback path and keeps offloaded parameters in pageable CPU memory, copying them to the GPU inside every wrapped `forward`. Under torch.compile those copies end up in the captured region, and PyTorch refuses to capture a copy from unpinned CPU memory, blocking or not (checked: `copy_` with `non_blocking=True` and `False` both raise the error above inside `torch.cuda.graph`). So no form of the fallback wrapper, including #46690's blocking copies, can run under CUDA graphs without pinned memory; the choice has to be made at config time.

The check sits in `CudaPlatform.check_and_update_config`, next to the existing WSL2 offload warning, and follows the existing pattern of disabling CUDA graphs with a warning for unsupported combinations (XPU graphs, MoonEP). The existing WSL2 warning about pinned-memory limits now fires only when pinned memory is actually in use.

Tradeoff: running without CUDA graphs is slower than WSL2 with pinned memory, but pinned memory on WSL2 is opt-in on purpose (see the existing warning about the WDDM pinned-memory cap), so this keeps that choice with the user instead of crashing.

Not tested: native Linux with pinned memory unavailable, ROCm, TP/PP, MoE or quantized models.

Duplicate check: no open or closed PR changes CUDA graph handling for offload without pinned memory. #46690 changes the fallback wrapper in `offloader/uva.py`, #43453 keeps scale parameters on the GPU, #50784 adds WSL2 troubleshooting docs without offload; none touch this config path.

AI assistance was used for implementation and validation. I reviewed every changed line and the results.

nodes.body: Friendly ping on this one. It still merges cleanly into current main, and neither the CUDA platform config check nor the UVA offloader has changed since, so `--cpu-offload-gb` without pinned memory (the default on WSL2) still leaves CUDA graphs on with pageable-memory copies inside the captured region. `pre-run-check` failed when I opened the PR, so pre-commit and CI never ran. Could a maintainer re-trigger them or take a look when there's time? Happy to rebase or change the approach if you'd rather handle this elsewhere.

This pull request has merge conflicts that must be resolved before it can be
merged. Please rebase the PR, @cheese-cakee.

Rebased onto 42258ca4. A correction to my last comment: I reran the no-pin case end to end on current main
(RTX 4050, WSL2, torch 2.14.0, Qwen3-0.6B, `--cpu-offload-gb 0.5`), and startup still fails with this PR. It now
fails before graph capture: Dynamo raises `Unsupported: setattr() on unsupported type OrderedDict` while tracing the
UVA fallback wrapper's `forward`, which calls `module.state_dict()`. Main fails the same way, and so does fc0cfcdc
with `cudagraph_mode=NONE`, so this failure is separate from CUDA graphs.

With pinned memory (`VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1`) the PR starts and its outputs match the no-offload run.

#46690 reworks that wrapper and drops the `state_dict()` call, so the no-pin path probably needs both. I'll test the
two together and report back here before asking for review.

As promised, I tested this PR together with #46690 on the no-pin offload path (RTX 4050, WSL2, torch 2.14.0, Qwen3-0.6B, `--cpu-offload-gb 0.5`, 3 greedy prompts x 32 tokens). #46690 no longer applies cleanly, so I ported its `uva.py` change onto this branch (base 42258ca4) and kept main's newer `prefix`, already-offloaded skip and `gpu_sync_allowed` changes. Its test file applied unchanged.

| Run | Startup | cudagraph_mode | Tokens vs no offload |
|---|---|---|---|
| this PR + #46690, no pinned memory | ok | NONE | identical |
| this PR + #46690, pinned (`VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1`) | ok | FULL_AND_PIECEWISE | identical |
| #46690 alone, no pinned memory | fails during CUDA graph capture: `Cannot copy between CPU and CUDA tensors during CUDA graph capture unless the CPU tensor is pinned` | | |

`tests/model_executor/test_uva_offloader.py` from #46690 passes (10/10) on the combined tree, and so does this PR's config test.

So the two fixes are complementary: #46690 removes the Dynamo failure from `state_dict()` in the fallback wrapper, and this PR removes the CUDA graph capture failure that appears next. The no-pin path needs both.

@yewentao256 @mgoin could one of you review this when you have time? It is a small config change (CUDA graphs off when offloading without pinned memory) plus a unit test, CI is green, and it merges cleanly into current main. @wgu9 FYI in case it helps #46690 move forward.

@@ -187,6 +187,32 @@ def test_rocm_resolves_the_mori_all2all_backend(monkeypatch, backend: str) -> No
     assert calls == expected
 
 
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="CUDA-specific test")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("pin_memory", "expected"),
+    [(False, CUDAGraphMode.NONE), (True, CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE)],
+)
+def test_cpu_offload_without_pinned_memory_disables_cudagraphs(
+    monkeypatch, pin_memory, expected
+):
+    from vllm.platforms.cuda import CudaPlatform
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        CudaPlatform, "is_pin_memory_available", classmethod(lambda cls: pin_memory)
+    )
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        compilation_config=SimpleNamespace(cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE),
+        offload_config=SimpleNamespace(uva=SimpleNamespace(cpu_offload_gb=1)),
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(worker_cls="test-worker"),
+        model_config=None,
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(),
+    )
+
+    CudaPlatform.check_and_update_config(config)
+
+    assert config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == expected
+
+
 def _sampling_replay_config(

     return_sampling_mask: bool = True,

@@ -348,6 +348,23 @@ def check_and_update_config(cls, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
             )

+            from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+
+            # Unpinned offloaded weights are copied to the GPU in every forward,
+            # and CUDA graphs cannot capture copies from pageable host memory.
+            logger.warning_once(

+                "graphs; disabling CUDA graphs. On WSL2, set "
+                "VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1 to keep them."
+            )
